title: 15章：拦拿扎神威断魂
content_zh:
熟悉的房梁，那是儿时的岁月时光，已经模糊的记忆，在月光下慢慢变得清晰了起来。

    不大的房间里，是自己孩童时期全部的天地，那时候，总是觉得外面的世界无限的广袤，又觉得世界就是那么的小，小到自己可以闭着眼摸索所有地方。

    后来，长大了，又觉得世界变得渺小起来，工作奔波与祖国各地，可是自己就像是一个飘零过客一般，匆匆而去，匆匆而回。

    世界很大，大到一个人错过后，这辈子都不会再见到。

    世界很小，小到最后你会发现，只有自己的家才是自己真正的归属之地。

    这两天发生了很多，无不在挑战着自己的神经，大喜大悲之下，张荼只觉得自己有些心力交瘁。

    情感，突变，责任，意义。

    我们一生都是为了什么？

    张荼感觉到一阵的迷茫，只觉得眼皮不断的互相拥抱，整个脑壳都昏昏沉沉的，只想睡去，可是又如何能睡去呢？

    大变已经来临，下一步该怎么做，家庭，家族，张荼觉得自己有义务扛起来。

    “边关月？”张荼小声的问道：“你睡了么？”

    “没有。”没有丝毫的感情，就像是一个旁观之人。

    张荼一时间对于边关月的声音所蕴含的感情多少有些不适应，但仍是平静的说道：“那个小院子，可以迁到这里来么？”

    “为什么？”

    “我只是觉得，这里可能更像是我的家，都说落叶归根，血浓于水。我以前不懂，可是这次回来之后，寰哥的态度，真的让我觉得，这里就是我的根，这里也是我的家，我总要为他们负责。”

    “你要知道，重情重义重感情，没有太多的好下场，你会很累的。”边关月说道，声音平静，不带一丝丝的情感：“你要想清楚，有些责任一旦扛起，可能就是甩之不掉的包袱和累赘。”

    “可我也不能不管他们啊。”张荼的目光透过窗纱看到外面的昏暗景色，静谧又让人安心，没有城市里的浮躁和喧闹，反而一时间觉得心安无比。

    “你确定？”

    幽幽的声音，像是仙人的质问，又似是来自九幽的诱惑。

    “确定！”

    张荼的声音斩钉截铁，没有丝丝的犹豫，或许自己跳起来的是一个千斤担，可苟富贵，勿相忘，一个好汉四个帮。

    孤零零的一个人，他不觉得有什么好的。

    “唔，希望你真的想好了。”边关月率先起身，说道：“随我来。”

    张荼微微一愣，嗯，你丫的睡觉不脱衣服的？

    看着悄然出门的边关月，张荼手忙脚乱的将衣服套上后，便是静悄悄的跟随在边关月的身后，一起出了门。

    “王城已经落地，想要再次迁移本就很困难，不过也幸好，当初落地后，你便是急躁的离去，我也没有跟你细说。”

    月光下的边关月，此时此刻，不知道是错觉还是怎么，张荼觉得他的发丝都在发着光。

    “现在我有一个办法，以妖族之血为祭，强行将王城迁移过来，这是目前一个可行的办法，就看你能不能做到了。”
content_en:
The familiar beams were from my childhood, and the blurred memories gradually became clear under the moonlight.

    The small room was the whole world of my childhood. At that time, I always felt that the outside world was infinitely vast, and at the same time I felt that the world was so small, so small that I could explore everywhere with my eyes closed.

    Later, when I grew up, I felt that the world had become smaller. I traveled to various parts of the motherland for work, but I was like a wandering passerby, leaving and returning in a hurry.

    The world is so big that if a person misses it, he will never see it again in his life.

    The world is so small that in the end you will find that your home is the only place where you truly belong.

    A lot happened in the past two days, all of which challenged his nerves. Under the great joy and sorrow, Zhang Tu only felt that he was a little exhausted mentally and physically.

    Emotion, mutation, responsibility, meaning.

    What are our lives for?

    Zhang Tu felt confused for a while, his eyelids kept hugging each other, and his whole head felt drowsy. He just wanted to sleep, but how could he sleep?

    Great changes have come, what to do next, family, family, Zhang Tu feels that he has the obligation to shoulder it.

    "Bian Guanyue?" Zhang Tu asked softly: "Are you asleep?"

    "No." There was no emotion at all, just like a bystander.

    Zhang Tu was a little uncomfortable with the emotion contained in Bian Guanyue's voice for a while, but he still said calmly: "Can that small courtyard be moved here?"

    "Why?"

    "I just feel that this place may be more like my home. They say that fallen leaves return to their roots and blood is thicker than water. I didn't understand before, but after I came back this time, Brother Huan's attitude really made me feel that this is my root and this is my home. I always have to be responsible for them."

    "You have to know that if you value love, righteousness, and feelings, there won't be many good endings, and you will be very tired." Bian Guanyue said, her voice was calm, without a trace of emotion: "You have to think clearly, once some responsibilities are shouldered, they may become burdens and burdens that cannot be shaken off."

    "But I can't ignore them." Zhang Tu looked through the window screen and saw the dim scenery outside. It was quiet and reassuring. There was no impetuousness and noise in the city, but he felt extremely at ease for a while.

    "Are you sure?"

    The faint voice sounded like a question from an immortal, but also seemed like a temptation from Jiuyou.

    "OK!"

    Zhang Tu's voice was decisive, without the slightest hesitation. Maybe what he jumped up was a thousand-jin load, but if you are rich and noble, don't forget each other, there are four gangs of good men.

    He didn't think there was anything good about being alone.

    "Well, I hope you have really thought about it." Bian Guanyue stood up first and said, "Follow me."

    Zhang Tu was slightly startled. Well, you don't take off your clothes when you sleep?

    Looking at Bian Guanyue going out quietly, Zhang Tu hurriedly put on his clothes, then quietly followed Bian Guanyue and went out together.

    "The royal city has landed. It is very difficult to move again. But fortunately, after landing, you left impatiently and I didn't tell you in detail."

    Bian Guanyue under the moonlight, at this moment, Zhang Tu felt that his hair was shining, whether it was an illusion or something.

    "Now I have a way to use the blood of the demon clan as a sacrifice to forcefully move the royal city here. This is a feasible way at the moment. It depends on whether you can do it."
title_en: Chapter 15: Stop Nazar’s power and break the soul
